key_insight: HARGO improves RL post-training for heterogeneous HPC tasks by weighting each response with a confidence-modulated advantage, instead of using uniform reward updates.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical alignment method for LLMs used in HPC workflows where tasks differ sharply in output format, length, and reward behavior.
method: Compute a group-level discrimination signal from reward contrast.
Compute a confidence signal from reference model log-probabilities.
Modulate the advantage to produce per-response importance weights without task-type labels.
evidence_signal: Across four HPC tasks and nine methods, HARGO achieved the best reported results on all three primary metrics: WinRate 54.62%, Data Race F1 91.30%, and PLP Similarity 0.8558.
watch_item: The method depends on accurate reward signals and reference-model confidence estimates, so performance may be sensitive to reward design and implementation details in new HPC tasks.
paper_title: HARGO: Heterogeneity-Aware Reward-Guided Optimization for RL Post-Training of LLMs on HPC Tasks
